scheme_name: Supply of Dhotis and Sarees to Scheduled Caste (SC) People
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant’s name must appear on the yellow or red ration card issued by the Civil Supplies Department
Applicant must have continuous residence in Puducherry for at least 5 years
benefits_summary: Male members receive a lungi and shirt; female members receive a saree and blouse annually.
